checks.detail: Web, desktop, and project authorities report 4.4.0.
Importer 3 validates signatures/decoding and records exact cache decisions without silent fallback.
Versioned presets and reproducible source/artifact provenance are serialized.
Inbound/outbound graph, cycles, duplicates, missing references, ownership, and inclusion closure exist.
Tags, collections, groups, list/grid, thumbnails, and bounded incremental asset windows are connected.
Five-tab importer, compare/revert, batch reimport, and platform overrides are connected.
Production sprite, slicing, collision, atlas, SVG, and platform controls are connected.
Search, world coordinates, chunk boundaries, deterministic storage, and TileMap history are connected.
Camera-retained composition adds repeating/mirrored parallax and reusable tangent paths with followers.
Runtime/editor font ownership and actionable multilingual glyph coverage are connected.
Malicious/corrupt/path/archive-style inputs receive explicit blocking diagnostics.
Folder/TileSet writes and external conflicts are transactional or explicit.
Export Folder left the primary toolbar but remains in overflow.
Rounded bundled fonts, quiet materials, purposeful motion, and reduced motion are defined.
New workflows are translated in English, German, and Chinese.
Bookmarkable multilingual v4.4 manual sections are present.
